svg.title: Make the comparison explicit before reading the counts
svg.desc: A two-by-two non-human model design crosses early/later developmental stage with unexposed/agent-X conditions. Each cell measures fictional marker M. Exposure dose and duration, measurement method and culture conditions should remain comparable within the intended comparisons. Learners compare exposed and unexposed proportions within each stage and then compare those contrasts while retaining sample sizes and uncertainty. No outcome bars or answer graph are supplied. Marker M is an indirect fictional indicator, not a diagnosed human condition or a precise human risk value; this digital reasoning model does not certify laboratory performance.

text.tspan: Make the comparison explicit before reading the counts
A simple factorial design separates stage and exposure in a non-human model.
Keep exposure duration, measurement method and culture conditions comparable.
Compare exposed and unexposed proportions within each stage.
Then compare the two contrasts; retain sample sizes and uncertainty.
Marker M is a fictional indicator—not a diagnosed human condition or precise human risk.
